name: tracker-managed-host-launch
goal: Prove the configured native and Docker launcher, nine-slot host admission, retained observed pane and legacy exit adoption using isolated processes.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Initial draft required an unbound external runner, applied a fixed two-slot cap, discarded the idle planner's observed-run closure, and could not observe a retained run after pane disappearance. The parent confirmed the migrated eight-plus-one and observed-pane cases and authorized synthetic proof only.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Use the foreground, provider process, retained-packet and pane method states to cover owned worktree startup, repeated attempt adoption, the nine-slot configured limit, due disk scoping, and exact legacy exit sentinel handling. Freeze all tests and fixtures for the paired record.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
